name: Facet Lantern
description: Rotate an original 3D facet lantern and connect labelled vertices until its requested polygon outlines are closed.
natural_language: Rotate the 3D lantern by dragging horizontally and click labelled studs to connect them. Close every requested polygon and reach the displayed target score. Use only screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network, source, DOM or page-state inspection, terminal, shell, Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload or navigation, browser extensions, external applications, hidden state, or unrelated tabs.

metadata.notes: Original rotatable-bipyramid implementation grounded in TRW-010 / Vertex Connector. The task preserves vertex identity across changing projections, persistent vertex connections, polygon bonuses, and isolated-vertex penalties; automated implementation evidence only, with human usability and empirical agent difficulty pending.
